limitations: Arm fits are constrained only over each published beta range and are not extended into unobserved sectors for visual symmetry.

The Reid 2019 fitted arm parameters assume R0 = 8.15 kpc; PCS retains that fit provenance while using the GRAVITY 2019 Sun anchor for the display frame.

layerAudit.determinism: All representative tracers use the versioned seed 4172019 and are generated once per layer load, never resampled per frame.

globalLimitations: This is an observation-constrained 3D reconstruction, not an external photograph of the Milky Way.
Displayed stellar-disk and stellar-halo extents are model display boundaries, not sharp physical edges.
Representative particles encode density context and must not be interpreted as individually catalogued stars.
Dust extinction, survey selection, incomplete southern VLBI coverage, distance uncertainty and arm-assignment ambiguity remain material limitations.
No dark-matter halo geometry is rendered.
